name: Grok Chief
author: moerdowo
description: Your desktop's chief of staff, wearing a drawn companion: an Omarchy-native creature that lives at the screen edge, takes orders through your configured AI agent, and keeps session-aware conversations in place. Its body is computed rather than blitted, so its shape, its colour and its resting expression are settings that morph rather than artwork that cuts. Drag or tuck it, move it across monitors, get replies in a bubble or hand work to Omarchy's native console, and keep status and settings one click away in the bar — without a daemon, hook, or extra package.

barWidget.description: Ask, check status, and dress your desktop companion.
